parsed.title: Daily News Reader Streak
parsed.oneLiner: Turn daily news reading into rewards with a streak tracker and bonus Reader Points.

newMechanic.name: Reader Loyalty Program
newMechanic.description: Daily reading streak tracking and rewarded point collection for user engagement.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: News apps lack inherent scarcity; this creates a habit loop for daily retention and unlocks rewarded ad inventory that complements organic reading.

parsed.trigger: Proactive entry via the daily streak badge on the News Feed Home screen.

offer.title: Daily Reader Bonus
offer.body: Play a 15-second game with our news mascot to get 50 Reader Points toward your daily streak.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: Points are cosmetic/loyalty based and carry no cash value, ensuring no IAP cannibalization. The streak reinforces habit and increases feed value.
risks: Users may ignore the task if Reader Points aren't perceived as valuable.
Potential for low engagement if the mini-game is not fun.
